def process(noaa_wildfires, raws_stations):
    # Check for common columns that could link the datasets
    noaa_cols = set(noaa_wildfires.columns)
    raws_cols = set(raws_stations.columns)
    
    print("NOAA columns:", sorted(noaa_cols))
    print("\nRAWS columns:", sorted(raws_cols))
    
    # Check if latitude/longitude can be used for matching
    print("\nNOAA lat/lon range:")
    print(f"  Latitude: {noaa_wildfires['latitude'].min():.2f} to {noaa_wildfires['latitude'].max():.2f}")
    print(f"  Longitude: {noaa_wildfires['longitude'].min():.2f} to {noaa_wildfires['longitude'].max():.2f}")
    
    print("\nRAWS lat/lon range:")
    print(f"  Latitude: {raws_stations['Latitude'].min():.2f} to {raws_stations['Latitude'].max():.2f}")
    print(f"  Longitude: {raws_stations['Longitude'].min():.2f} to {raws_stations['Longitude'].max():.2f}")
    
    # Check elevation data in RAWS
    print(f"\nRAWS Elevation stats:")
    print(f"  Non-null count: {raws_stations['Elevation'].notna().sum()}")
    print(f"  Min: {raws_stations['Elevation'].min()}")
    print(f"  Max: {raws_stations['Elevation'].max()}")
    print(f"  Mean: {raws_stations['Elevation'].mean():.2f}")
    
    return raws_stations[['Station Name', 'Elevation', 'Latitude', 'Longitude']].head(20)
